summary: Serialize continuity event and checkpoint index transactions

delivery.outcome: Serialize continuity journal/index writers, reject stale checkpoint sequences without corrupting storage, recover the index on replay, and publish immutable standard 0.20.61 after protected delivery.
nonGoals: Change continuity schemas or external controller fencing
Add dependencies or mutate foreign checkouts
Wire the new suite into CI; deferred to a separately scoped dependent ticket

architecture.decision: Use a stable per-stream operating-system file lock across journal validation, append and atomic index replacement; share the lock with index rebuild. Bound acquisition time, preflight index size and repair the advisory index on idempotent replay.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Two real processes reproduce stale concurrent capture, independent ticket index loss and concurrent rebuild races; replay restores interrupted index writes and bounded-index rejection appends no event. CI wiring is a dependent follow-up with its own public-interface budget.
Native governance and required CI pass without changing protected authority.
Independent exact-head merge and final immutable standard v0.20.61 release are verified.
